native_mechanisms: Two rows of beast-pawns on a shared road: one row fixed, the second slipped forward at exactly one house by the horse's-head piece, tried at every house and at none (single-gap shift trials).
House-by-house comparison marking agreement with a lotus petal and disagreement with a red knot, paced one count per flute note (per-cell match +1 / mismatch -1 tally).
Gather each trial's knots into a fist, weigh it, and keep only the lightest fist while flinging all others away (minimise mismatch count over trials; discard the rest).
core_technique: Banded Needleman–Wunsch DP (scalar rolling band, plus an AVX2 anti-diagonal wavefront in 16-bit lanes) with the band width W derived from a lower bound obtained by scoring a handful of single-shift Hamming comparisons.
